name: Bulk Craft
description: Craft one by hand, then craft many: look at a crafting station and press U for x5 / x10 / x25 / max of a recipe you crafted there by hand, or type /craft <n> in the chat (every player on your server). Crafted by the game itself from your own materials, one at a time at the recipe's own pace. Host or dedicated server; players who join need nothing. Installed switched off.

settings.label: Bulk craft key (host)
settings.help: Look at a crafting station (or at nothing, for hand crafting) and press it: the wheel offers what you crafted there by hand.

options.label: One at a time (the recipe's crafting time, at least the time below)
All at once (recipes with a crafting time still wait for it)

settings.label: Seconds per craft (recipes without a crafting time)
Most crafts per order
settings.help: Max in the wheel and /craft max stop here too.

settings.label: Station within (m)
settings.help: Walk farther away and the order stops.

settings.label: Notes on screen
settings.help: When your order starts and ends (the host's screen; players who joined get chat lines).
